scene: the adult stands on a sandy beach drawn as a flat line with a few small dunes at the left, small wave edges rolling onto the sand at the feet, and a plain beach chair beside. Land fills the whole bottom of the picture and the sea lines lie ahead.
must: a person on sand with waves arriving at the feet.
avoid: an adult on a boat with only water all around (op zee); an adult swimming in the sea (not the card); an adult in a harbour with moored boats (not the card); an adult beside a lake (not the card).
contrast: Pair with op-zee. The only difference is what lies around the adult: sand and dunes under the feet here, only water in every direction there.
example_nl: Zij wonen al jaren aan zee.
example_en: They have lived by the sea for years.
alt: Een vrouw staat op het zand met een handdoek over haar schouder en golven aan haar voeten.

scene: the adult stands on the deck of a small plain fishing boat holding a rope, the hull riding the sea lines, and water drawn in every direction to a bare horizon with no land, no dune and no shore anywhere. A single gull circles above the mast.
must: a person on a boat with water and a bare horizon all round.
avoid: an adult on a beach with waves at the feet (aan zee); an adult in a boat on a small lake with a shore near (op het water); a ship docked in a harbour (not the card); a lighthouse on the horizon (not the card).
contrast: Pair with aan-zee. The only difference is what lies around the adult: only water to a bare horizon here, sand and dunes under the feet there.
example_nl: De vissers zijn op zee.
example_en: The fishermen are at sea.
alt: Een man staat op het dek van een kleine boot en overal om hem heen is alleen maar golvend water.

scene: a large round sun with long straight rays stands high in the top corner of the picture and the adult on the bench squints with one hand shading the eyes, short sleeves, nothing overhead but sky. A small short shadow line lies under the bench.
must: a big sun with rays and a hand shading the eyes.
avoid: an adult under a tree on the same bench (in de schaduw); an adult under a rain cloud (in de regen); a sun at the horizon on its own (not the card); an adult with sunglasses on a beach (not the card).
contrast: Pair with in-de-schaduw and in-de-regen. The only difference is what is above the bench: a bare sky with a sun and rays here, a leafy tree or a rain cloud there.
example_nl: Wij zitten graag in de zon.
example_en: We like sitting in the sun.
alt: Een man zit op een bankje met zijn hand boven zijn ogen en een grote bol met stralen boven zich.

scene: a leafy tree stands behind the bench and a broad branch reaches over it, its crown drawn with a hatched shade pattern on the bench and the adult; the sun with rays is drawn small in the top corner beyond the leaves. The adult sits relaxed with the hands in the lap.
must: a bench under a branch, with hatching across the sitter.
avoid: an adult squinting in open sun (in de zon); an adult under a rain cloud (in de regen); a tree with no person (not the card); an adult under an umbrella (not the card).
contrast: Pair with in-de-zon and in-de-regen. The only difference is what is above the bench: a leafy branch with hatched shade here, a bare sky with a sun or a rain cloud there.
example_nl: Het is koel in de schaduw.
example_en: It is cool in the shade.
alt: Een vrouw zit op een bankje onder de takken van een boom met gearceerde vlekken op haar jas.

scene: a plain cloud outline hangs above the bench with rows of straight diagonal rain lines falling on the adult, who hunches with shoulders up and wet hair, no umbrella and no hat. Small puddle rings are drawn on the ground line.
must: straight rain lines falling on a hunched person.
avoid: an adult squinting in open sun (in de zon); an adult under a leafy tree (in de schaduw); an adult holding an umbrella (not the card); a cloud with no rain (not the card).
contrast: Pair with in-de-zon and in-de-schaduw. The only difference is what is above the bench: a cloud with rain lines falling on the sitter here, a bare sky with a sun or a leafy branch there.
example_nl: Zij fietst in de regen.
example_en: She cycles in the rain.
alt: Een man zit gebogen op een bankje terwijl er lange schuine lijntjes uit een wolk op hem vallen.

scene: the adult lies face up with the back flat on the mat, arms along the sides, eyes looking at the sky and the nose pointing up, both knees slightly bent. The chest and the face are the highest points of the body.
must: a person lying face up with the chest toward the sky.
avoid: an adult lying face down with the head on folded arms (op je buik); an adult lying on one side (not the card); an adult sitting up (not the card); an adult asleep in a bed (not the card).
contrast: Pair with op-je-buik. The only difference is the body position: face up with the nose to the sky here, face down with the chest on the mat there.
example_nl: De baby ligt op zijn rug.
example_en: The baby is lying on its back.
alt: Een man ligt languit op een matje en kijkt omhoog.

scene: the adult lies face down on the mat with the chest and stomach flat on it, the head turned sideways toward the viewer and resting on folded arms, the soles of both shoes pointing up. The back is the highest point of the body.
must: a person lying face down with the soles of the shoes up.
avoid: an adult lying face up with the chest to the sky (op je rug); an adult lying on one side (not the card); an adult doing a press-up (not the card); an adult crawling on hands and knees (not the card).
contrast: Pair with op-je-rug. The only difference is the body position: face down with the soles pointing up here, face up with the nose to the sky there.
example_nl: Ik slaap graag op mijn buik.
example_en: I like sleeping on my stomach.
alt: Een vrouw ligt op een matje met haar kin op haar armen en de zolen van haar schoenen omhoog.

scene: the adult and the child both walk upright along the ground line, the child's small hand held inside the adult's hand with the arms hanging between them, all four feet on the ground. The child looks up at the adult.
must: two walking figures with small hand held in big hand.
avoid: an adult holding the child up on one arm (op de arm); an adult sitting with the child on the lap (op schoot); two adults holding hands (not the card); a child walking alone (not the card).
contrast: Pair with op-de-arm and op-schoot. The only difference is how the child is with the adult: walking on its own feet holding a hand here, carried or sitting on the lap there.
example_nl: Mijn dochter wil altijd aan de hand lopen.
example_en: My daughter always wants to walk holding my hand.
alt: Een vrouw en een klein meisje wandelen naast elkaar en de kleine vingers zitten in de grote.

scene: the adult stands and holds the child high on one forearm against the chest, the child's feet hanging off the ground line and one small arm round the adult's neck. The adult's other arm is free and the child looks over the shoulder.
must: a child lifted off the ground on one arm.
avoid: an adult and child walking hand in hand (aan de hand lopen); an adult sitting with the child on the lap (op schoot); a child on the adult's shoulders (not the card); a child in a pram (not the card).
contrast: Pair with aan-de-hand-lopen and op-schoot. The only difference is how the child is with the adult: lifted on one forearm with feet off the ground here, walking by the hand or sitting on a lap there.
example_nl: De moeder draagt het kind op de arm.
example_en: The mother carries the child in her arms.
alt: Een man staat met een klein kind hoog tegen zijn borst, de voeten van het kind hangen in de lucht.

scene: the adult sits on a plain chair facing sideways, with the child sitting on top of the adult's thighs, the child's feet dangling above the floor line and the adult's arm round its back. Both look ahead and nothing else is on the chair or the floor.
must: a child sitting on top of the adult's thighs on a chair.
avoid: an adult and child walking hand in hand (aan de hand lopen); an adult carrying the child while standing (op de arm); a child on its own chair (not the card); a child on a swing (not the card).
contrast: Pair with aan-de-hand-lopen and op-de-arm. The only difference is how the child is with the adult: sitting on the adult's thighs while the adult sits here, walking by the hand or lifted standing there.
example_nl: Het kind zit op schoot.
example_en: The child is sitting on my lap.
alt: Een vrouw zit op een stoel met een kind op haar knieën.

scene: the adult stands with both forearms crossed in front of the chest, each hand tucked under the opposite upper arm, feet slightly apart, the face calm as in the frame. The shoulders are level and nothing is held.
must: two forearms crossed flat over the chest.
avoid: an adult with both hands high and open (met de handen omhoog); an adult with the hands pushed into the trouser pockets (met de handen in de zakken); an adult with the arms hanging at the sides (not the card); an adult hugging someone (not the card).
contrast: Pair with met-de-handen-omhoog and met-de-handen-in-de-zakken. The only difference is the arms: crossed over the chest here, raised or hidden in pockets there.
example_nl: Hij staat met zijn armen over elkaar.
example_en: He is standing with his arms folded.
alt: Een man staat recht voor je en kruist zijn onderarmen voor zijn borst.

scene: the adult stands with both arms stretched straight up beside the head, palms open and fingers spread, the face calm as in the frame. The feet stay flat on the ground line and nothing is held.
must: both open hands raised high above the head.
avoid: an adult with the arms crossed over the chest (met de armen over elkaar); an adult with the hands in the pockets (met de handen in de zakken); an adult waving one hand (not the card); an adult in a victory pose with fists (not the card).
contrast: Pair with met-de-armen-over-elkaar and met-de-handen-in-de-zakken. The only difference is the arms: both raised with open palms here, crossed on the chest or hidden in pockets there.
example_nl: Zij staat met de handen omhoog.
example_en: She is standing with her hands up.
alt: Een vrouw strekt beide handen hoog boven haar hoofd met gespreide vingers.

scene: the adult stands with both hands pushed deep into the trouser pockets so only the wrists and the thumbs show, the elbows slightly out, the head straight and the face calm as in the frame. The shoulders are level.
must: wrists disappearing into two trouser pockets.
avoid: an adult with the arms crossed over the chest (met de armen over elkaar); an adult with both hands raised high (met de handen omhoog); an adult with one hand in a coat pocket (not the card); an adult holding a bag (not the card).
contrast: Pair with met-de-armen-over-elkaar and met-de-handen-omhoog. The only difference is the arms: hands hidden in the pockets here, crossed on the chest or raised high there.
example_nl: Hij loopt met zijn handen in de zakken.
example_en: He walks with his hands in his pockets.
alt: Een man staat ontspannen; zijn handen zijn niet te zien.

scene: behind the adult stand tall block buildings with grids of identical windows on both sides of the path, one street lamp and a plain kerb in front, a tram line crossing at the back. No field, hill or tree fills the background.
must: tall buildings with window grids all along the path.
avoid: a flat field with a farm and furrows (op het platteland); three pointed mountain peaks (in de bergen); a single house in a garden (not the card); a village with a church (not the card).
contrast: Pair with op-het-platteland and in-de-bergen. The only difference is the setting: tall buildings and a street lamp here, fields with a farm or mountain peaks there.
example_nl: Zij werkt in de stad.
example_en: She works in the city.
alt: Een wandelaar loopt langs hoge gebouwen met veel ramen en een lantaarnpaal.

scene: behind the adult spreads a wide flat landscape with parallel furrow lines in a field, a farmhouse with a low barn and a single plain tree, the horizon low. No tall buildings and no peaks are in sight.
must: a flat field with furrows and a farm.
avoid: tall block buildings along the path (in de stad); three pointed mountain peaks (in de bergen); a garden behind a fence (not the card); a forest of dense trees (not the card).
contrast: Pair with in-de-stad and in-de-bergen. The only difference is the setting: flat furrowed fields with a farm here, tall buildings or mountain peaks there.
example_nl: Mijn opa woont op het platteland.
example_en: My grandfather lives in the countryside.
alt: Een wandelaar loopt langs een kale vlakte met voren, een boerderij en een enkele boom.

scene: behind the adult rise three high pointed peaks with a jagged skyline, a steep slope with rocks, and the path winding uphill; a pair of walking sticks hangs on the backpack. No building or field is in sight.
must: three tall pointed peaks behind an uphill path.
avoid: tall block buildings along the path (in de stad); a flat field with a farm (op het platteland); a single round hill (not the card); a cable car (not the card).
contrast: Pair with in-de-stad and op-het-platteland. The only difference is the setting: pointed peaks and a steep path here, tall buildings or flat fields there.
example_nl: Wij wandelen in de bergen.
example_en: We are hiking in the mountains.
alt: Een wandelaar loopt een steil pad op, met drie scherpe toppen achter zich.

scene: outside the window a half sun rises at the bottom edge of the window with short rays, the lamp above the table hangs unlit, and the adult sits at the table holding the cup in both hands. Nothing else is on the table and no moon or star is drawn.
must: a half sun at the window edge with the lamp unlit.
avoid: the same window dark with the lamp lit (avonds); a full sun high in the window (not the card); an adult asleep in bed (not the card); a clock face (no numbers in the art).
contrast: Pair with avonds. The only difference is the light: a rising half sun and an unlit lamp here, a dark window and a lit lamp there.
example_nl: 's Ochtends drink ik thee.
example_en: In the morning I drink tea.
alt: Een man zit met een kop aan tafel terwijl de zon net boven de rand van het raam uitkomt.

scene: the window is filled with plain dense hatching and shows no moon and no stars, the lamp above the table is lit with short rays, and the adult sits at the table holding the cup in both hands. Nothing else is on the table.
must: a dark hatched window and a lit lamp over the table.
avoid: the same window with a rising half sun and the lamp unlit (ochtends); a crescent moon and stars, which mean night (not the card); an adult asleep in bed (not the card); a sunset over the sea (not the card).
contrast: Pair with ochtends. The only difference is the light: a dark window and a lit lamp here, a rising half sun and an unlit lamp there.
example_nl: 's Avonds lees ik een boek.
example_en: In the evening I read a book.
alt: Een vrouw zit met een kop aan tafel onder een brandende lamp; het raam is donker.

scene: SKIP: the meaning lives in a sign or a price board, and no text or numbers may appear in the art; a house alone shows nothing.
example_nl: Het huis is te koop.
example_en: The house is for sale.

scene: SKIP: the meaning lives in a sign, and no text may appear in the art; the contrast with te koop cannot be drawn.
example_nl: De kamer is te huur.
example_en: The room is for rent.

scene: SKIP: first time needs a before and an after; a single picture shows no earlier occasion and no memory may be drawn as text.
example_nl: Ik ben voor het eerst in Utrecht.
example_en: I am in Utrecht for the first time.

scene: SKIP: last time needs a sequence that has ended; a single picture cannot show that nothing follows.
example_nl: Ik zie hem voor het laatst.
example_en: I see him for the last time.
